gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Funnel Display loops along in spaghetti-like strokes up top, while the serif below stays easy to follow paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-pridi: Marker-traced and commanding, Funnel Display looks drawn with a single tip, every line the same width. But Pridi, a serif with generous gaps at its curve ends, keeps long paragraphs unhurried and clear.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified Suwannaphum stands tall, its high x-height squared off like a woodblock letter. And Funnel Display, drawn in spaghetti-like strokes with no swelling where curves meet stems, leads, then hands off to the serif.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-hepta-slab: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. And Hepta Slab stretches each word out, bookish and dignified, its strokes never shifting in weight.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-kiwi-maru: Drawn with one nib, Gabarito opens its terminals outward and grabs attention. Kiwi Maru, traditional and editorial, looks best with its size nudged up, giving its far-stopping terminals room.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is a serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, classic and editorial in its manner. Goldman spreads wide and bold, a loud neighbor for such open curves.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is a bookish, dignified serif whose tall rounded letters keep their counters large and open. Goldman spreads wide and bold beside it, brash against that open text.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-epunda-slab: Constant-width lines make Grandstander look cut from a single stroke, with short ascenders. And Epunda Slab, a serif with a visibly gaping c, carries long paragraphs in a dignified, rounded rhythm.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-glegoo: Curves and straights share a single width in Grandstander, which keeps its letters held open. And Glegoo, refined and editorial, lets its big counters and wide mouths carry long paragraphs gracefully.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-epunda-slab: Gugi stands out for lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals. Gugi is best at announcing, with open-cut terminals, while Epunda Slab, with its gaping c, is best at carrying the text.
